subject.title: fix(codex): require explicit final source delivery

question: Should Codex message-tool-only completion permanently require explicit `final=true`, or should confirmed source delivery remain implicitly terminal with prompt-only sequencing guidance?
rationale: Both implementations are technically viable but establish different durable model/runtime semantics, so source inspection and CI cannot resolve the intended product contract.

options.title: Explicit final contract
options.body: Require Codex to mark only the completed current-source reply final, giving progress sends durable non-terminal semantics.

options.title: Prompt-only sequencing
options.body: Preserve implicit confirmed-delivery termination and rely on developer instructions to prevent source-message progress sends.

recommendation.title: Explicit final contract
recommendation.body: Require Codex to mark only the completed current-source reply final, giving progress sends durable non-terminal semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the broadest recent history across the Codex runtime and shared message-tool surfaces involved in the contract choice.
